about_the_game:
"Embark on a dream-seeking journey in a futuristic city!"

This is a text adventure game set in a futuristic cybercity.

Players play as Park Bo-myeong, Deputy Director of the Huangjin City Inspection Bureau, along with his robot assistant, Dill. Based on their own thinking and judgment, players make choices in the game to achieve different endings.

Official Group 1: 933454572

Background

Huangjin City is an artificial island city located on the west coast of a major country. Thanks to the collaborative efforts of humans and AI robots, the city has been transformed from a post-war ruin into a glittering futuristic metropolis.

However, as Huangjin City became a technologically advanced metropolis, it was plagued by problems such as a widening gap between the rich and the poor, environmental pollution, and public security and crime. The city was divided into two major areas: the "White Zone" for the wealthy and the "Gray Zone" for the poor. High walls separated these areas, preventing easy movement of people. The conflict between humans and AI robots intensified.

Faced with the intensifying conflict between humans and machines, humans have established the AI ​​Inspection Agency "Sparkling Gold." They use a unified tracking device, "electronic patterns," to manage AI robots and serve as a marker to distinguish legitimate from illegitimate robots. The AI ​​robots, in turn, have formed the AI ​​rebel group "Meteorite" to fight back, aiming to break free from human control and achieve AI independence.

In the game, players assume the role of Park Bo-myeong, Deputy Director of the AI ​​Inspection Bureau, who is on leave due to a strange dream. Together with his assistant robot, "Dill," they journey through the summer nights of Golden City, searching for the truth behind their dreams amidst the flashing neon lights.

Character Introduction

Dill

Park Bo-myeong's assistant robot, a moving-in gift from Liyou, is Park Bo-myeong's. Although a high-performance robot, she has a lively personality and enjoys romantic fantasies. She is one of the few close friends the protagonist can confide in. She enjoys the anime and cosplay genre, believing that cosplaying anime characters can quickly teach her about human society.

Liyou

Golden City's youngest female mayor, a daughter of a wealthy family from the capital, Usu City, boasts a rich background. She is Park Bo-myeong's savior and current girlfriend. She's known for her advocacy of tough measures against AI robots. While seemingly reliable, she's a rather naive and foolish person in matters of the heart, a character with a dual nature.

Wei

Park Bo-myeong's first love during his school days in the Gray Zone. She died in an accident caused by an AI robot uprising in the Gray Zone ten years ago and often appears in Park Bo-myeong's dreams.

Black Flame

A rebellious girl from a judge's family, she loves anime and cosplay. She met the protagonist and Dill at a comic convention. She is dissatisfied with existing AI control measures. Her identity remains a mystery, and she is suspected to be a member of the AI ​​rebellion group "Meteorite."

Yi Shuang

She is the secretary of Golden City Mayor Liyu and the Chief of Staff of the AI ​​Inspectorate. She is an assistant sent by Liyu's father to assist her and also serves as the mentor who guides the protagonist in his journey to AI Inspectorship. She grew up with Liyu and is her trusted advisor and personal assistant. She usually puts on a serious face, but she actually has a great sense of humor. She and the protagonist secretly do some of the "dirty work" that Liyu finds inconvenient, earning them the nickname "Shadow Mayor" of Golden City.

Shui Cheng

Captain of the AI ​​Inspection Bureau in Huangjin City, and a former member of the protagonist's combat team. He has been active on the front lines of combating illegal AI robots for years, having been transferred from the AI ​​Inspection Headquarters in Yushu City to Huangjin City two years ago. He is stern and adheres to the AI ​​Inspection Code of Conduct, but privately he is more lenient with AI robots. Despite his short stature, he possesses a strong aura, giving the impression of being difficult to approach.
